Edit target: the supplied wide pixel-art alpine landscape for a racing game. Keep the same crisp 16-bit pixel-art style, blue sky, blocky white clouds, snow-capped mountain range, mountain scale and composition. Remove ALL evergreen trees from the image: the large pines on both sides, every small tree, every forest band and every tree silhouette on the foothills. Replace their regions with uninterrupted bare alpine mountain slopes and gently overlapping grassy foothills. The image must contain only sky, clouds, mountains and bare rolling foothills, with no trees, bushes, forest, buildings, road or vehicles anywhere. The nearest foothills along the bottom should be a quiet medium grassy green around #43844b so they can blend smoothly into a grassy racetrack foreground. Preserve wide landscape framing and the high mountain peaks. No text or border. This is the distant backdrop only; the game renders all trees separately in its foreground.
